hosts.useGlobalMetricsDesc: Override with the server-wide metrics interval

use.title: Use Host Metrics
use.description: View host metrics and use the host managers (services, packages, firewall and more) on hosts you can reach.

metricsInterval.label: History sampling interval (seconds)
metricsInterval.description: How often samples are stored for the history charts, unless the host sets its own interval. Live views are controlled by the live settings below.

historyRetentionDays.label: History retention (days)
historyRetentionDays.description: How long metrics samples are kept for the history charts.

liveEnabled.label: Live updates
liveEnabled.description: Lets users open the lightweight live view of CPU, memory, network and processes. Separate from the history sampling interval.

liveMinInterval.label: Live update minimum (seconds)
liveMinInterval.description: The fastest a host is sampled for live updates, however many users or tabs are watching. Users can pick slower rates; a faster choice is raised to this minimum.

temperatureUnit.label: Temperature unit
temperatureUnit.description: How temperatures are shown in Host Metrics.

liveInterval.label: Live update rate
liveInterval.description: How often CPU, memory, network and processes refresh in the Host Metrics tab, the terminal toolbar, and dashboard and homepage widgets (those never go faster than every 5 seconds). Each update reads /proc on the host. Never faster than the server's live update minimum. Off keeps the slower regular sampling.

backgroundGraceS.label: Background grace period
backgroundGraceS.description: How long the page can be hidden (for example while you alt-tab) before Host Metrics disconnects from the host. Coming back within this time keeps the connection.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the metrics panel with new terminals
companionAutoOpen.description: Show live metrics beside every SSH terminal. You can still open and close it from the button on the right edge.

companionSide.label: Metrics panel side
companionSide.description: Where the metrics panel sits next to a terminal.

companionSize.label: Metrics panel size
companionSize.description: Width in pixels, or height when it is at the bottom. You can also drag its edge.

companionEdgeButton.label: Show the panel button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the right edge of a terminal that opens the metrics panel.
